model: TCW210-TH temperature and humidity data logger
applies_to: TCW210-TH per the Teracom TCW210-TH user manual Revision R1.26, firmware V2.012 or later.
summary: The TCW210-TH is a Teracom Ethernet data logger for up to eight temperature or temperature/humidity sensors on 1-Wire or Modbus RTU. Over Modbus TCP it serves each sensor's values, raw values, limits, trim settings and alarm flags as holding registers.

addressing.note: The address table prints PDU (wire) addresses in decimal. The manual's example frame reads register 19800 as 0x4D58 on the wire, so no offset is applied.

notes: Word order: the manual says float registers are sent big-endian and its example response 41BD 0655 decodes to 23.628, i.e. high word first (ABCD).
Strings are fixed-length UTF-8, zero padded; 64-byte fields span 32 registers.
Each of the 8 sensors has three value slots (Sx1..Sx3), each with dimension, limits, multiplier, offset, value, raw value and alarm status.
Left out: 'Number of installed sensors' (PDU 18000), listed only as '16-bit Integer' without saying signed or unsigned.

registers.description: Shows or triggers saving of the configuration.

integration.summary: Enable Modbus TCP, then read sensor values as floats from holding registers 19800 onward (two registers per value) with function 03.
integration.enable: Modbus TCP/IP is disabled by default. Enable it on the services page of the web interface (standard port 502).
quirks: PDU 50000 reports whether settings are saved (0 = unsaved, 1 = saved).
setup: The factory IP is 192.168.1.2; change it in the network settings, then enable Modbus TCP/IP.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
